nodes.label: Constrained Query Expansion (Step 0, REQUIRED)
nodes.rationale: The query CLI matches via case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming, no synonyms, no cross-language match — a wording mismatch collapses the answer to 0 hits. Fix by expanding the question using only tokens actually present in the graph's label vocabulary (up to 12, printed for auditability); never invent or substitute near-synonyms. If nothing matches, say so and stop.

nodes.label: BFS / DFS Traversal with Token Budget
nodes.rationale: BFS (default, depth 3) gives broad context / nearest neighbors; DFS (depth-limited to 6) traces a specific dependency chain. Output is ranked by relevance and cut at a token budget (~4 chars/token, default 2000). If the CLI is unavailable, an inline NetworkX traversal of graph.json is the fallback; answers must cite source_location and never hallucinate edges.

nodes.label: save-result Feedback Loop and Work Memory (reflect / LESSONS.md)
nodes.rationale: Closes a self-improving loop: answers (with the expanded-token trace) are saved back so the next --update extracts the Q&A as a graph node. An --outcome (useful / dead_end / corrected) plus --correction feeds graphify reflect, which refreshes LESSONS.md with preferred sources, known dead ends, and prior corrections; --if-stale makes a session-start refresh near-free when the git hook already ran it.

nodes.label: /graphify path — Shortest Path Between Concepts
nodes.rationale: Finds the shortest path between two named concepts via the CLI or inline nx.shortest_path, prints each hop with relation and confidence, and the agent explains in plain language what each hop means before saving the result back.

nodes.label: /graphify explain — Single-Node Explanation
nodes.rationale: Finds the best-matching node, prints everything connected to it with relations, confidence, and source files, then the agent writes a 3-5 sentence explanation using source locations as citations and saves it back.
